## Joins

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
# opsjoner
options(paged.print = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# it's a tibble
flights |> class()
```

```{r}
flights |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
airlines |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
airports |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
weather |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  # note x = flights, y = airlines
  left_join(
    y = airlines, 
    by = join_by("carrier")
    )
```

```{r}
flights %>% 
  select(carrier, name, everything()) %>% 
  head(3)
```
